title: Satish Sharma v. State of U.P. — writ against 30.7.2017 notice withdrawn with liberty under clause 6.5
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ petition withdrawn with liberty to raise a clause 6.5 dispute.
headnote: A writ challenging a 30.7.2017 notice was withdrawn with liberty after the Court recorded that a dispute under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 could be raised against such a notice.
facts: Satish Sharma filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court challenging a notice dated 30 July 2017 issued by respondent no. 3. Counsel for the State and for respondent nos. 2 and 3 appeared. The Court recorded that it was not in dispute that a dispute against such a notice could be raised under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Confronted with that, counsel for the petitioner sought withdrawal of the writ with liberty to raise the dispute under clause 6.5.

holding_units.holding: A notice of the kind dated 30 July 2017 may be the subject of a dispute under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ challenging that notice was disposed of as withdrawn with liberty to raise such a dispute.

not_decided.note: Writ withdrawn without examining the notice; liberty reserved to raise a clause 6.5 dispute.
